questions.solution: ${21} over {10}$$45°<x<90°$에서 $sinx>cos`x$이다.$sqrt {LEFT ( sin`x+cos`x RIGHT ) ^{2}} - sqrt {LEFT ( sin`x-cos`x RIGHT ) ^{2}} = {4} over {5} `$$|sinx +cosx |- |sinx - cos | = 4 over 5$$sinx + cosx - sinx + cosx = 4 over 5$$2cosx = 4 over 5$, $cosx = 2 over 5$, $cos(90°-x) = sinx = root21 over 5$, $tanx = root21 over 2$$cos` LEFT ( 90° -x RIGHT ) TIMES `tan`x` = sinx ×tanx = root21 over 5 ×root21 over 2  = 21 over 10$
